profile.headline: Senior IT Consultant Specializing in Software Development
profile.summary:
I'm a highly qualified Senior IT Executive with a great track record. My attached resume covers all of this. 
What I can bring to any organization is strong leadership focused on results. I've worked with and for owners and C-Suite Executives most of my career. I know how to apply technology to solve business issues while providing ROI. Additionally, I've always kept my hands on the technical side so that I can communicate effectively with software engineers.

positions.title: IT Director of Software Development
positions.description: Joined this local company with a long history in the community to help develop an outstanding IT capability and support the double digit growth goals over the next 5 years.

positions.title: Consultant - Product Development
positions.description:
The Health Navigator platform is a comprehensive clinical vocabulary and decision-support system designed to support eHealth and telemedicine encounters – from presenting chief complaint to the final diagnosis. The platform includes a broad range of tools for capturing the chief complaint through natural language processing, presenting a documentation checklist to consumers and healthcare providers, generating a list of possible causes, and making recommendations for seeking care. These tools can be used to develop symptom checker, consumer engagement, and telehealth applications. All content is delivered via a well-documented application programming interface (API; RESTful web service). Health Navigator can provide solutions for eHealth, telemedicine, insurers, medical call centers, electronic health record companies, answering services, and healthcare systems.  

I'm a thought leader working closely with the founder to help build web applications that demonstrate the use of their natural language processor to extract symptoms from patient complaints, clinical decision support content, and a differential diagnoses generator.  I consult in all areas of business development and help lead technical design and development.

positions.title: Vice President - Information Technology
positions.description: Top IT position for this mid-sized ER, Hospitalist, and Telemedicine physician staffing organization reporting to the owner. Accountable for strategic planning, governance, capital and operational expense, direction and daily leadership. The company doubled revenue and their client list while maintaining a flat operational IT budget. Microsoft CRM and SharePoint were installed. Agile methodologies were adopted. Extensive .NET/SQL Server web applications were developed to expand and replace legacy applications.

positions.title: Vice President - IT
positions.description: Accountable for the strategic planning, governance, direction and daily leadership of a 14 person staff and a $4.9 million budget overseeing all IT functions, systems and equipment. Expanded staff and managed software development in support of significant growth. Responsible for introducing .NET, web services, SOA and other new technologies to help retire legacy applications. Regular contact and support for several Fortune 500 organizations (e.g. Merck, Pfizer, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Sanofi-Aventis, Delta Airlines, United Airlines, American Airlines, etc.) to manage national drug sample distribution and separated luggage deliveries. The IT organization supported double digit revenue growth for 4 years and helped increase the value of the company which ultimately made it an attractive acquisition for ThermoFisher Scientific.

positions.title: Co-owner
positions.description:
Established this new company to provide consulting services. Our strengths include Supply Chain expertise within the automotive industry, business process redesign, and large scale project management and development.

•	Key Assignment: Daimler Chrysler Financial Services – Coordinated multiple projects including the creation of an enterprise-wide environment to test the overall integration of Mercedes and Chrysler Lease and Loan applications.

positions.title: IT Director (Executive)
positions.description:
IT Director (Executive), Federal-Mogul Corporation, Southfield, MI 		09/95 – 08/01

Responsible for a 26-person team managing all North American aftermarket distribution and logistics systems from manufacturing to customer delivery. Additional dotted line reporting relationship to the EVP of global distribution and logistics who had me manage several global projects. The company made significant acquisitions and my team consolidated multiple ERPs. Systems ran in +80 factories, domestic warehouses and distribution centers, dozens of international distribution centers supporting thousands of end-users.   

IT Manager, Federal-Mogul Corporation, Jacksonville, AL 			07/93 – 08/95
Re-located as IT Manager and Re-engineering Manager. IT staff of 7 supported all systems running this heavily automated 350,000 sq. ft. warehouse. Led development of new Warehouse Control System for case conveyor system interfaced to PLC’s. Developed new receiving application using PowerBuilder and reengineered several internal processes using both technology and Kanban systems.  

Team Leader, Federal-Mogul Corporation, Southfield, MI			04/89 – 07/93
Assigned to work closely with the VP of Distribution and Logistics in support of internal initiatives. Major project helped determine least cost routing through the supply chain for over 45k SKUs leading to reduced labor, shorter lead times, higher fill rates, and lower inventory. 

On-site Liaison, Federal-Mogul Corporation, Alameda, CA			03/87 – 03/89
Re-located to Alameda, CA to supervise the software development by a 3rd party systems integrator (Integrated Automation – a division of Litton Industries). The project was a $23 million expansion of the North American distribution center and included extensive warehouse automation, and all major warehousing applications.

volunteerExperience.description:
Rotary is an international service organization doing amazing things around the world. Our club here in Traverse City has done several global service projects along with providing local support through numerous efforts. 

We have a focus on clean water initiatives and kids. For the last several years, our Backpacks for Kids signature project has provided backpacks and school supplies for those in need.  Related to Rotary, I've done fund raising for a water filtering project in India and visited Indian villages where a Mumbai club built dams. I've hosted youth exchange kids and served on the board for 2 years along with serving as Club Secretary for two years.
